post.description:
Purchase tickets for an experience.

**API v1** (`Accept: application/json; version=v1`):
The next upcoming occurrence is selected automatically; `occurrence` must not be supplied.

**API v2** (`Accept: application/json; version=v2`):
The caller must supply an explicit `occurrence` ID. Passing an occurrence that belongs to a different experience than the selected tickets will return a 400 error.
